description: Cast portraits: batch-generate candidates on the local GPU (script) → Creative Director picks winners (Opus) → owner gate.

stages.task: Mode B review for the studio cast. For each agent in .studio/roster.json (except owner), LOOK at its candidates in .studio/portraits/candidates/<id>_*.png. Pick the better one (on-model for the role, clean face and hands, no text or artifacts, consistent style with the rest of the cast) and copy it to .studio/portraits/<id>.png with `cp`. If both are bad, regenerate that character with `node tools/creative/portraits.js --only <id> --seeds 4` and pick again. Write docs/creative/cast/review.md: a table of id | chosen file | why, plus any character that still needs work.

stages.title: Cast portraits are live in the Control Room. Keep them?
